dedupe_keys.name: resouce adequacy assessment and electricity market simulation jericho raaems

description: Resouce Adequacy Assessment and Electricity Market Simulation (JERICHO-RAAEMS) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Chair for Energy System Economics (FCN-ESE); Institute for Future Energy Consumer Needs and Behavior; RWTH Aachen University. The model optimizes the cost-minimal dispatch of multi-node energy systems and highly interconnected electricity markets. It is embedded in a scenario-based Monte Carlo framework to reflect uncertainty and randomness for economic or reliability analyses. Coverage: Multi-node system; primarly applied to European bidding zones. Methodical focus: Resource Adequacy, Market Simulation, Probabilistic Power System Assessments. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
